mapper.select: SELECT h.biz_type AS bizType, h.biz_id AS bizId, CASE WHEN h.biz_type = 1 THEN q.title WHEN h.biz_type = 2 THEN kb.title WHEN h.biz_type = 3 THEN t.title ELSE CONCAT('CONTENT#', h.biz_id) END AS title, CASE WHEN h.biz_type = 1 THEN LEFT(q.content, 80) WHEN h.biz_type = 2 THEN kb.summary WHEN h.biz_type = 3 THEN t.subtitle ELSE '' END AS subTitle, h.viewed_at AS viewedAt FROM ( SELECT biz_type, biz_id, MAX(created_at) AS viewed_at FROM user_browse_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= #{retainedFrom} GROUP BY biz_type, biz_id ) h LEFT JOIN qa_question q ON h.biz_type = 1 AND q.id = h.biz_id AND q.delete_flag = 0 AND q.status = 1 LEFT JOIN kb_entry kb ON h.biz_type = 2 AND kb.id = h.biz_id AND kb.status = 1 LEFT JOIN qa_topic t ON h.biz_type = 3 AND t.id = h.biz_id AND t.status = 1 WHERE ( (h.biz_type = 1 AND q.id IS NOT NULL) OR (h.biz_type = 2 AND kb.id IS NOT NULL) OR (h.biz_type = 3 AND t.id IS NOT NULL) ) ORDER BY h.viewed_at DESC, h.biz_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT biz_type, biz_id FROM user_browse_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= #{retainedFrom} GROUP BY biz_type, biz_id ) h LEFT JOIN qa_question q ON h.biz_type = 1 AND q.id = h.biz_id AND q.delete_flag = 0 AND q.status = 1 LEFT JOIN kb_entry kb ON h.biz_type = 2 AND kb.id = h.biz_id AND kb.status = 1 LEFT JOIN qa_topic t ON h.biz_type = 3 AND t.id = h.biz_id AND t.status = 1 WHERE ( (h.biz_type = 1 AND q.id IS NOT NULL) OR (h.biz_type = 2 AND kb.id IS NOT NULL) OR (h.biz_type = 3 AND t.id IS NOT NULL) )
mapper.delete: DELETE h FROM user_browse_history h LEFT JOIN qa_question q ON h.biz_type = 1 AND q.id = h.biz_id AND q.delete_flag = 0 AND q.status = 1 LEFT JOIN kb_entry kb ON h.biz_type = 2 AND kb.id = h.biz_id AND kb.status = 1 LEFT JOIN qa_topic t ON h.biz_type = 3 AND t.id = h.biz_id AND t.status = 1 WHERE (h.biz_type = 1 AND q.id IS NULL) OR (h.biz_type = 2 AND kb.id IS NULL) OR (h.biz_type = 3 AND t.id IS NULL) OR (h.biz_type NOT IN (1,2,3))
